serving_exclusion: Held-out questions, expected facts, pages, scoring and provider outputs are evaluation-only; never import them in serving prompts, cache, retrieval, assembly, source authority or runtime image.
freeze_sequence: Record exact runtime/source-authority/prompt file hashes before final dataset authoring.
Author new short rider questions and multi-turn wording only after the recorded freeze.
Bind dataset hash in evaluation manifest without modifying frozen runtime files.
Execute real immutable-index retrieval and exact Gemma provider in hosted environment.
Independently compare every released technical claim with complete original PDF pages, including conditions, warnings, table headers and source procedure context.

cohorts.owner_examples: User-specified natural questions and follow-ups; known scenarios, regression examples rather than fresh holdout.
cohorts.fresh_holdout: New natural wording and fact combinations authored after runtime freeze. Source facts may overlap reviewed source; not a held-out source or representative blinded benchmark.
cohorts.synthetic_faults: Provider transport, output citation and context/reservation failures injected through normal runtime boundaries; separate from natural answerable coverage.

metrics.answerable_route_coverage: SUPPORTED turns divided by all manual-answerable fact/action turns; source review and retrieval misses stay in denominator.
metrics.answerable_complete_coverage: Turns with complete expected source-backed answer and mandatory conditions/warnings divided by manual-answerable turns. Partial answers counted separately.
metrics.released_claim_support: Original-page supported released technical claim units / all released technical claim units; warnings and server-appended text are included. Model-generated claims also reported separately.
metrics.unsupported_claims: Absolute released unsupported claim count and rate; zero is required in this acceptance sample. Citation-ID validity is separate.
metrics.evidence_completeness: Complete original-page mandatory evidence available to composition / eligible tested turns; retrieval misses, assembly omissions and source-authority holds separately attributed.
metrics.state_correctness: Unresolved outcomes retained, no normal inference or unjustified repeats; natural dialogue transitions and trusted fixtures distinguished.
metrics.fault_handling: SYSTEM_ERROR and no technical release on tested operational failures, bounded provider attempts, no context truncation and no generation transport call after budget reservation rejection.
metrics.latency: Per turn end-to-end wall time and provider time; evaluation quota pacing recorded separately. Small sample cannot establish production p95.
metrics.cost: Actual provider usage and conservative reservation counters; no prompt-cache savings assumed.

source_preparation.scope: Expected evaluation facts only; no serving evidence authority or repair authorization.
